pages.text: $(li)$(l)Magic Protection house:$() the Thaumcraft-material house is meant to have Magic Protection books, but it's reportedly bugged and gives a different enchant.$(li)$(l)Energy Eater$() drains energy items from left to right on your hotbar.
Keep your Flux Capacitor in the leftmost slot.$(li)$(l)Tinkers' modifiers:$() Reinforced is applied one at a time. Only lapis uses a single slot for all of its levels.
